g.text: Troubleshooting
Problem
What to check
Errors about the | symbol in
type hints
You are using a Python older than 3.10. Update Python and install again.
NameError: name 'RiseIn' is not
defined
Animations and easings must be imported, as in from svgblock import RiseIn,
Sequence, EaseOut.
ValueError: Unclosed marker
A marker (**, __, --, ##) was opened and never closed. Every marker needs a
closing twin. To write a literal one, put a backslash before each of its characters.
A style appears or vanishes
where it should not
Text that contains **, __, -- or ## toggles a style, even a double hyphen used as a
dash or a name like __init__. Escape those characters with a backslash.
Markers show up literally in a
title or a table header
Only paragraphs and table cells read markers. Titles, subsections and table
headers are drawn as plain bold text.
SyntaxWarning: invalid escape
sequence
Python is warning about the backslash. Use a raw string (an r before the opening
quote) or write the backslash twice.
ValueError from table, columns,
divider or image
Every table row needs as many cells as columns, align and weights need one value
per column, a divider coverage must be between 0 and 1 and an image width must
be greater than zero.
The image is missing or fails to
load
The path is read when you run the script, relative to the folder you run it from.
Check that the file exists there.
A title, a subsection or a very
long word goes past the border
Titles and subsections stay on a single line, and a word bigger than its space
cannot fit. Shorten the text, reduce the font_size or increase the width.
Words are broken in the middle
inside a table or a column
A narrow column cannot fit a long word, so it is broken. Give that column a larger
weight, shorten the text or increase the width of the block.
Lines break earlier or later than
expected
The width of the text is estimated with the Arial font. On a system without Arial the
browser uses another font, so lines can look slightly different. Emojis and curly
quotes are measured as a full letter wide.
ValueError about duration,
distance, start_scale or amount
Durations, sizes and amounts must be greater than 0, and distance must be 0 or
more. start_scale also cannot be greater than 1, and the amount of Jelly must be
between 0 and 1.
ValueError about loop_limit
loop_limit must be from 0 to 1000, or None for no limit. In a sequence, only the last
step can be infinite.
ValueError about x1, x2, count
or bounce
In CubicBezier, x1 and x2 must be between 0 and 1. In Steps, count must be a
whole number of 1 or more. In Spring, bounce must be greater than 0 and at most
ValueError: the blur would go
below 0
An easing that goes past its limits, such as EaseOutBack() or Spring(), pushed the
blur of FocusIn, FocusOut or focus=True below 0. Use an easing that does not
overshoot.
TypeError: unexpected keyword
argument 'loop_limit'
Only ambient animations (Pulse, Float, Sway, Shake, Rotate, Drift and Jelly) and
Sequence accept loop_limit. Entrances and exits play once. To repeat them, put
them in a Sequence.
TypeError: unexpected keyword
argument 'easing'
PopIn, PopOut, FlickerIn, FlickerOut, GlitchIn, GlitchOut, Show and Hide have a
fixed timing. To control it, change the duration.
TypeError: unexpected keyword
argument 'fade' or 'focus'
FadeIn and FadeOut have neither. FocusIn and FocusOut have fade, and blur sets
their focus. Flicker and Glitch have neither.
TypeError: a step must be an
animation, or easing must be
an Easing
Animations and easings are objects, so they need parentheses: RiseIn(), not
RiseIn, and EaseOut(), not EaseOut. Names in quotes, such as "rise" or "ease-out",
are not accepted.
ValueError: Step N of the
sequence would never play
An earlier step has loop_limit=None and never ends, so nothing after it can play.
Move the infinite step to the end of the sequence.
The loop_limit of my sequence
does nothing
When the last step is infinite, the sequence never reaches its end, so it cannot
repeat. Use a finite last step.
ValueError: This sequence
repeats too much
The repetitions of a sequence are counted one by one and cannot pass 10,000.
Reduce a loop_limit or use None.
The animation does not play
An animation without a loop plays once, when the image loads, so reload the page
to see it again. To replay an entrance, use a Sequence with a Show step and
loop_limit=None. Nothing plays for people who turned on reduce motion, or in
viewers that do not run animations. Open the file in a browser to check.
My pulse only pulses once
loop_limit is 0 by default, which means a single run. Use loop_limit=4 for five pulses
or loop_limit=None for no limit.
Shake or Jelly stops moving
after a while
They lose strength on purpose and stop after a few swings. Use shakes or wobbles
to lengthen them, or loop_limit to repeat them.
The block disappears and
never comes back
An exit ends with the block hidden. To bring it back, put an entrance after it in a
Sequence, or make the sequence infinite with loop_limit=None.
The exit goes the opposite way
from what I expected
RiseOut, DropOut, SlideOut and SpinOut keep going the way their entrance was
moving. To leave the way it came, use the opposite exit: Sequence(RiseIn(),
DropOut()).
The block jumps between two
steps of a sequence
svgblock does not blend steps: each one starts from its own state. After an entrance
the block is in place, and a new entrance starts from its beginning. The same
applies after an exit, which leaves the block hidden. Choose steps that fit together,
or separate them with a Show step.
The block is cropped while it
moves
The block is only visible inside the image. Entrances and exits come from outside it,
so they can start or end cropped. With fade=False, a large distance makes the
block start outside the image. Reduce the distance or keep the fade on.
The block looks smaller than
width
Animations that make the block bigger than normal (Pulse, Jelly, Glitch, or Zoom
with a scale above 1) and ambient animations that move, turn or blur it get room
inside the image, so the block rests smaller than width and is never cropped. Rotate
asks for the most.
The image is much taller with
Rotate
A full turn needs room for a whole circle, so the image makes space above and
below the block. Use a smaller angle, as in Rotate(angle=30), or Sway.
Spring or Bounce does not look
right
They use the CSS linear() function. In an old browser or viewer, the easing may be
ignored. Open the file in a recent browser to check.
AttributeError: Theme has no
attribute ...
The theme does not exist in the Theme enum. Names are uppercase, exactly as
shown in the Themes section (for example Theme.NEON). To use a color scheme
that is not there, create your own ThemeData.
An error that names a color,
such as KeyError: 'divider'
Your ThemeData is missing that color. Every theme needs all of them. See the list
in Creating Your Own Theme, or start from a copy of a ready-made theme.
A theme changed in blocks
where I did not expect it
Theme.NAME.value.update(...) changes the shared theme for the whole program.
To change only one block, use Theme.NAME.value.copy(), edit the copy and pass it
to that block.
My theme edit has no effect
Make the change before the blocks that use it are drawn, and check that the color
name is spelled exactly as in the list of theme colors.
The block does not show on my
page
Check that the path in the img tag matches the file name exactly (paths are case
sensitive on most servers, including GitHub) and that the .svg file is published
together with the page.
